artifact_inventory.inventory_definition: SHA-256 of compact canonical JSON over sorted relative path, byte count, and file SHA-256 records before audit publication. Viewer logs are live presentation logs and may append after this snapshot.

checks_not_performed: No GPU rerender or pixel-level metric replay
No report rendering, manifest generation, or child/root HTML inspection
No WebGL visible-content or orbit-camera browser smoke
No full repository verify; downstream driver retains render/smoke/docs/verify obligations
checks_performed: Task-specific official-lock and live 103-file source-binding replay
Strict task-specific semantic and transitive artifact-hash replay for one warmup plus all 36 measured cell bundles

Independent per-view held-out means, validation AUC/clocks, per-folder medians, paired seed differences/wins, resource clocks, CUDA/RSS mappings, split isolation, endpoint chronology, and NPZ/PLY counts
25 focused Janelle protocol tests, including viewer failure/retry recovery

chronology.note: The final retry overwrote coordinator entry/exit timestamps; initial-attempt coordinator receipt chronology is not retained. Per-worker input bindings and all cell artifacts remain independently sealed.

claims.basis: Task/review/data/source/lock hashes match; one heldout-free warmup and 36/36 unique measured cells pass strict semantic receipt and transitive artifact-hash replay.
claims.claim: The official result is the complete execution of the prospectively approved task, data, source, command, warmup, and 36-cell matrix.

claims.basis: For every one of the six folders, masked has the favorable direction in 3/3 paired seeds for all four metrics. This does not attribute the effect separately to field placement or RGB masking.
claims.claim: The joint masked field-lift plus masked RGB-refinement arm improves held-out foreground PSNR, crop SSIM, alpha IoU, and exterior leakage relative to the joint unmasked arm.
claims.scope: each folder separately, this one Janelle frame, end-to-end arm only

claims.basis: Masked full-canvas PSNR is lower in 3/3 paired seeds for every folder; median paired differences range from -7.974 to -9.496 dB.
claims.claim: The masked foreground gains trade away full-canvas background fidelity.
claims.scope: each folder separately, this one Janelle frame

claims.basis: AUC is favorable in 3/3 paired seeds for each folder; independent trapezoidal replay differs from producer values by at most 7.105427357601002e-15.
claims.claim: The masked arm improves frozen validation foreground-PSNR AUC on the observer-excluded optimizer clock.

claims.basis: No fixed threshold or threshold-crossing metric was frozen or published, and the aggregation policy forbids pooling/ranking the six folder units. AUC does not answer this claim.
claims.claim: Higher-capacity or boundary-aware folders reach a fixed validation-quality threshold sooner.

claims.basis: Fresh-process clocks and CUDA/RSS receipts replay exactly, but arm order is fixed, host load/idleness evidence is absent, final capacities differ, and the six folders must not be pooled. No speedup, real-time, or general performance claim is supported.
claims.claim: The masked arm is generally faster or more memory efficient.

claims.basis: The protocol expressly permits receipted carrier reduction and freezes this claim out of scope.
claims.claim: The bounded deterministic field carrier preserves every source 2D Gaussian component or complete field fidelity.

claims.basis: Final receipt records six exact reused live/HTTP-ready processes after all endpoints, and all six URLs returned HTTP 200 during audit. The initial incomplete receipt was overwritten, so its exact failure record is not independently available. WebGL visible-content/orbit browser smoke remains downstream.
claims.claim: The first viewer launch failed closed and the same-root retry recovered all six viewers; the viewers are visually usable.

claims.basis: Single development frame, no external method comparator, no confirmatory scene, and no idle-host throughput protocol.
claims.claim: The result establishes cross-scene generality, state-of-the-art quality, GPS-Gaussian reproduction, production-default suitability, or real-time performance.

substage attribution between field-lift masks and RGB-refinement masks
real-time, speedup, idle-host performance, or production-default claims
complete preservation of every source 2D Gaussian
supports: per-folder development-only end-to-end masked versus unmasked foreground/silhouette/full-canvas tradeoff
per-folder validation-AUC direction on the frozen optimizer clock
structural completion, isolation, endpoint, count, and resource accounting for this run
